name: routines_withdraw
description: Withdraws one pending routine proposal that the assistant made, so it never runs. Use it when the user says they no longer want a proposal, or it was made by mistake. It cannot touch approved or rejected proposals, nor any active routine or trigger: removing those is for the user, on the page or from the command line. Needs the proposal id: call routines_list first. Returns one confirmation line.

proposal_id.description: The proposal id as routines_list shows it (e.g. p-3f2a9c).
